### **About Us**


Since our establishment in 2005, we have been focused on helping our clients build their Software Products/Projects.  

  

  

Our founders had software development engineering background, our focus has always been in having strong delivery capability. This has resulted in extremely happy clients from day one and we continue to be the preferred partner for the clients we have acquired in our first year.  

As we continued our journey and growth, we have expanded our team with different technology stacks and right technical solutions. Our 200\+ people team continues to pleasantly surprise our clients across different technologies.  

### **Job Description**


**The role**
------------

  

We need senior hands now. The AI practice runs several concurrent client platforms in regulated industries, and the engineering team supporting them is early\-career. The Technical Lead becomes the day\-to\-day technical owner of that team: the person who turns architecture decisions into implementable designs, runs the design gate, reviews the code, unblocks the hard problems personally, and tells the Chief Architect and delivery leadership the truth about risk.

  

Expect the split to be roughly half hands\-on engineering and half oversight. The hands\-on half is the difficult half: retrieval architecture, agent orchestration, extraction accuracy, performance and cost. The oversight half is where you multiply — three to five engineers with one to two years of experience become independent owners of their workstreams within six months because of how you review, mentor and set standards.

**What will you do**
--------------------

* Own technical delivery of AI workstreams across concurrent client engagements: scope, design, sequencing, quality and honest estimates.
* Run the pre\-implementation design gate: review engineers' design notes, apply the tiered checklist, maintain the decisions register, and approve or send back before code is written.
* Set and enforce engineering standards for LLM systems — evaluation suites as release gates, prompt and model versioning, cost and latency budgets, guardrails and injection defenses, human approval gates, evidence and audit trails.
* Personally build the hardest components: retrieval and re\-ranking architecture, tool\-calling and agent orchestration on Temporal, document extraction pipelines, on\-premises and offline deployments.
* Review code at scale, including code produced with AI coding tools; catch invalidated model output, leaked secrets, missing tests and silent behavioral change before they merge.
* Mentor early\-career engineers with a deliberate plan: pair on design, grade their design notes, expand their ownership as they earn it.
* Represent engineering with clients: explain trade\-offs in plain language, push back on unsafe or unbounded asks, and turn vague requirements into a bounded phase\-one scope.
* Hold the security posture: secrets management via Vault and Key Vault, data residency, least\-privilege access, and client confidentiality on on\-premises work.
* Build reusable Centre of Excellence assets — evaluation harness, RAG reference implementation, guardrail library, extraction patterns — so that the method travels across clients even when the code cannot.
* Assess codebases and delivery risk candidly and communicate upward early, including when the news is unwelcome.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

* Two or more LLM systems that you shipped to production and operated, each with measurable quality gates. You can describe the incidents, what you measured, what you changed, and what you would do differently.
* Deep Python and strong system design: multi\-tenant SaaS, asynchronous pipelines, event\- or workflow\-driven orchestration, data modelling on document and relational stores.
* Evaluation rigor as a habit: you have built eval datasets, chosen the metrics, and used them to block a release.
* Cloud depth on Azure preferred (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AKS or App Service, Key Vault); AWS or GCP equivalents acceptable if the principles transfer.
* Led a team of three or more engineers through delivery, including design reviews and code reviews you were accountable for.
* Judgment about where a model does not belong, and the standing to say so to a client who wants one everywhere.
* Clear written communication: design documents, decision records, risk memos. Comfortable in client\-facing technical conversations.

**What would set you apart**
----------------------------

* Temporal in production; durable, idempotent, resumable workflow design.
* Document AI at depth: tiered OCR strategies, layout analysis, extraction accuracy measurement on real\-world scanned records.
* Computer vision for inspection or verification use cases (DETR\-family detectors, DINOv2 backbones, ensembling and box\-fusion methods) and release gates expressed as per\-class recall.
* Compliance frameworks applied to software delivery: GxP and 21 CFR Part 11, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS.
* Test automation strategy with AI\-assisted authoring (Playwright), and the governance of AI coding tools inside an engineering team.
* Experience running a small engineering practice or CoE: standards, reusable assets, training, hiring.

title: Data Platform Ops Engineer
description:

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving digital world. We're looking for curious minds who are passionate about building and operating scalable cloud platforms, enabling reliable data solutions, and driving automation across modern cloud environments. If you enjoy solving operational challenges, improving platform reliability, and creating automation that makes a real impact, you might be the perfect fit for our team.

**We are looking for a Platform Ops Developer.**
------------------------------------------------

### **You'll make a difference by:**

  

* Developing, maintaining, and continuously enhancing automation for cloud data\-platform operations, deployments, monitoring, and recurring maintenance activities.
* Operating and improving production infrastructure for data\-processing workloads on AWS, including Kubernetes/EKS, EMR on EKS, S3, IAM, networking, and related cloud\-native services.
* Building operational tools, frameworks, and scripts that reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and increase reliability across environments.

* Enhancing platform observability by defining metrics, alerts, dashboards, operational checks, and runbooks for data platforms, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* Supporting incident management activities including root\-cause analysis, release validation, environment readiness, operational audits, and continuous process improvements.

* Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and operational best practices.
* Experience supporting large\-scale data platforms, analytics environments, or data\-processing workloads.
* Knowledge of AWS cost optimization, resource governance, and cloud security best practices.

* Experience working with Apache Spark, EMR, or distributed data\-processing frameworks.
* Exposure to platform engineering concepts and self\-service infrastructure enablement.
* Understanding of security, compliance, identity management, and governance in cloud environments.

* An attractive and competitive compensation package.

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.
